name: HOOK
thought: Tail grab, banana bite, espresso on hold.

diary.line: Waterfall Pond: new spot, same flawless tail. Obviously.
I slipped past the flickering neon, examined the cabinet's cracked screen, and imagined my tail curling around the joystick for a perfect press.
I curled my tail around a low‑poly banana bunch, yanked a ripe one, and ate it in one bite, letting the peel swing as a silent reminder of my skill.
I drifted off in the hammock, the low‑poly breeze humming, and woke to a stray pixel firefly buzzing near my tail, reminding me the night’s still young.
I hooked my tail over a rusted pipe jutting from the trunk, let it swing, and sipped espresso while the ambient hum of the server farm droned on.
I used my tail to yank the CRT remote off the dusty shelf, flipped the channel, and let the static dance while I chewed on my toothpick.
I anchored a pulsing holo‑panel to the islet’s rim, then launched into a backflip, tail latching the edge as the platform lit up.
I snatched a pulsing pixel‑apple with my tail, let it hover a beat, then tossed it back to the tree for the show.
I perched on the arcade cabinet, tail coiled around the corner, and let the pixel lights flicker as I stared down the crowd.
I let my tail hook the lowest frond, plucked a glowing pixel‑berry, and tossed it back, just to prove the grip works.
I hung off the Hang Tree and combed the bark with my tail, finding a smooth knot and a mossy hollow in the trunk. Good shelf spot. Espresso survived.
I looped my tail around a palm frond, yanked a banana, peeled it in one swipe, and chomped while the sun glinted off the blocky leaves.
